context_closeout_cases: Passing acceptance and owner writebacks cannot bypass mandatory semantic closeout

Default show/resume and mutation output omit old plans, check history and owner receipt history; explicit --history preserves access
Current conclusions, decisions, retained IDs, limitations and regression evidence remain discoverable
Original failed observations and test logs remain recoverable after newer evidence; corrupted originals block closure

Code, plan, evidence, checkpoint, decision source and owner changes invalidate the relevant closeout
Previously retained IDs require evidenced disposition before removal
Static pass does not imply independent recovery; real failed trial cannot become NOT_RUN to bypass closure
